title: Bound approximate-call errors in the complete QQ16 decoder
body:
This contributes a conditional **componentwise absolute-error budget** for PR2540's unchanged 2,463-event QQ16 decoder at every positive payload tensor depth `lambda`, complementing PR2603's exact caller-grid result. Errors are measured by the maximum absolute real or imaginary component over all owners and payload addresses.

Publication-time overlap: [PR2628](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2628) (`e64a7babb285f22baeee89a9d88f5e79c512909a`) and [PR2670](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2670) (`0ce9c0f1f2b42b2e403801ea79f55a21cdf6e035`) now supply and audit a maximum-per-owner **payload Hilbert-norm** contract, including cover-map defects and state-relative feedback. They explicitly leave physical component rounding open. The distinct result here propagates absolute component errors using the tensor line/stage box norms, assumes exact cover maps, and gives separate ADD/line/stage allowances. It does not replace their broader defect model or instantiate a rounded child. [PR2663](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2663) separately handles borrowed-field reuse; this package is a single-invocation contract. These related results appeared after the package's recorded preparation snapshot and were checked before publication.

For per-event componentwise tolerances `eps_add`, `eps_line` and `eps_stage`, every decoded output has error at most

```text
(928 + 784*2^(4*lambda))*eps_add + 49*eps_line + 392*eps_stage.
```

Borrowed Y return error is separately bounded by `(1+2^ceil(lambda/2))*eps_line`; X is unchanged and exact CLEARs reset owned scratch. With one common tolerance, every declared caller boundary has error at most `(1369+784*2^(4*lambda))*epsilon`, or **13,913 epsilon at one layer**. Local errors at most `2^-(q+4*lambda+10)` therefore suffice for strict error below `2^-q`.

Only `research/qq16-decoder-error-budget/` is added. It includes the written proof, byte-exact source snapshots, registered replay, a forward nonnegative-polynomial certificate and a separately implemented reverse sensitivity checker. No predecessor verifier is imported. The bound is conservative, not a sharp physical amplification or minimum precision claim.

Validation passed on macOS arm64: the Python 3.12.13 registered replay, optimized direct checks on Python 3.10.20 and 3.14.8, and primary/reverse checks on Python 3.15.0. Coverage includes all 2,248 changed-field boundaries, 224 decoded outputs, agreement on all 464 exit-field polynomials, 1,020 directly summed Gaussian Fourier coefficients, source corruption and meaningful underbudget controls. The selected baseline binding check passed on the pinned preparation base.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-decoder-error-budget
```

The theorem assumes the inherited native gate semantics, exact cover maps/wrappers/CLEARs, writes only to the declared destination, restored child-private workspace, and uniform local error bounds on the actual perturbed inputs. F0/B1 entry errors, child-internal rounding/range/cost, physical hosting, global controller admission and the full supplier bill remain open. The selected cold replay and predecessor native admission replays were not run. **No new kappa or full multiplication theorem is claimed.**

Preparation base: canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Sources: PR2540 `630d557af5088f66b45c447969cee9576600e50b`; PR2603 `961288204c6138deac2bf8cf6ea348560bcf56d6`, both still unchanged at submission. On 2026-10-15 at 17:28–17:32 UTC, submission refresh found main at `b5ea56e0a5ac4552166253b1fa4be0753bb38c30`, priority revision 5. The new guidance/family record still permits this scoped local precision lemma; no family expansion is proposed. The selected record and registered package runner are unchanged, and a virtual merge with refreshed main has no conflicts. The older scientific pins and approved commit are intentionally retained. The refreshed, fully paginated overlap covers 784 open PRs (17:30 UTC) and 1,320 Discussion records (17:32 UTC), with no warnings; the committed TASK retains its earlier preparation snapshot. This is bounded public coverage, not a novelty guarantee.

Credit ywz65's PR2540/2603 and PR2511/2512, Ali Romman's QQ16 lineage, thakrarsagar/PR2470 and starship-s/PR2443. Original source attribution is retained.
